result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. The full offline test suite passes.

I changed `listOpenInRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/SupportTicketStore.java`. The priority ordering used by the sales-rep list is now a shared constant, `PRIORITY_THEN_OLDEST_FIRST`, that both methods use, so the two orders can't drift apart. The only caller of the ticket version is the region overview, so no other screen changes.

I also added `openTicketsOfTheRegionAreListedByPriorityThenOldestFirst` to `RegionManagerTest`. It uses your example and checks that closed and other-region tickets stay out. Nothing is committed.
